prompt: High-fidelity PRODUCT UI COMP B for Keylane, personal Chrome extension launcher for fixed internal web sites. Portrait 420x720, actual narrow extension panel only, no browser frame, no poster. Same grounded visual world as engineer dispatch ledger: warm matte ivory #F4F1E9, graphite #17242B, safety orange #E6683E only for the primary action, fine ledger rules, small numeric markers, typography crisp modern sans with mono for hostnames. Make this a more compact and efficient arrangement than a generic card layout: slim Keylane topbar, command-search directly below, a one-line CURRENT PAGE strip with '当前页面 · nas.example / 已匹配', then a section '常用站点' listing five synthetic items with generous 52px rows. Each row has site name, hostname, concise credential type text (固定密码, 时间戳, 自定义 JS), a small right-side orange '进入' button. Bottom anchored '全部站点' and '设置'. One row displays permission-needed state clearly as text '需授权' and a different action '授权'. Do not show real passwords, no SSO, no claim of authenticated success, no Kimi brand, no chat UI, no gradients or decorative imagery. Text and controls must be readable and recognizable as a functioning extension panel.
approvalBasis: User delegated design decisions; selected for one-click scanning, explicit permission state, and narrow extension fit.
